name: Fuse & Bulb Replacement
summary: Second pass used the BMW ST502 E90 training documents and the BMW ETK catalog (RealOEM decode of the VIN tail: E90 LCI 328i sedan, N52N, built 09/2009, US) to close most bulb and fuse gaps. CLOSED: fog bulb conflict (H8 12V 35W on 2009+ LCI; H11 was the 2006-2008 bulb); halogen headlight bulb is H7 12V 55W (ETK, 4 per car) and front turn signal bulb PY24W; xenon bulb is D1 12V 35W (D1S); option codes S522A (xenon) and S524A (adaptive headlights) identified in ETK; trunk fuse situation (rear power distribution box on top of the battery has non-replaceable fusible links); glove-box junction box location (BMW ST502 plus 4 secondary); fuse colour/amp coding (ETK); fuse numbering differs by build date. STILL OPEN: engine-bay E-box/front power distribution box physical location and access, fuse puller location, a verified full fuse chart for this exact build (two web charts agree with each other but are not independent and not BMW documents), halogen low-beam access detail beyond 'service openings in the wheel arch cover', tail light bulb-to-function mapping on LCI, and the halo/angel-eye bulb type on halogen LCI lamps (H8 vs H10W conflict). Publish fuse section (glove box + 'follow the cover diagram') and a bulb section gated on headlight type.
variantDependencies: Headlights: standard halogen (ETK: H7 12V 55W, qty 4 for low+high beam, PY24W yellow front turn bulb) vs bi-xenon (ETK: D1 12V 35W) which BMW ST502 says is only installed with Adaptive Headlight Control on the launch E90; ETK option codes S522A = Xenon Light, S524A = Adaptive Headlights. Which the car has needs the VIN option list or a look at the lamp.

Fog lights: H8 12V 35W (ETK diagram for build 2009; Turner lists E90 2009+). Pre-LCI 2006-2008 used H11 55W (Turner). M Aerodynamics fog lamps are a separate ETK diagram. Conflict with earlier ledger resolved for this 09/2009 build.
Angel-eye/halo bulb: H8 on xenon/adaptive lamps (E90Post, Turner); on LCI HALOGEN lamps one retailer guide says H10W - CONFLICT.

Fuse layouts differ by production date (E90Post: numbering changes at 09/2007; fuseandrelay shows Type 1 and Type 2 with Type 2 from 08/2007); this car should follow the newer layout but must be checked against the sticker on the glove-box cover.

Tail lamps: ETK lists rear light assemblies with bulb sockets and bulbs P21W x4, H21W x2, W16W x2 for the 2009+ model (older assemblies ended 03/2010). Whether some functions are LED is not established; E90Post owners describe LED LCI tail lights.
Front turn signal: ETK shows a PY24W bulb on the halogen diagram but LED turn-signal units in the xenon/adaptive rows (applicability not established).

specs.value: On top of the battery; contains fusible links that cannot be replaced individually; replace as complete unit. No user-serviceable trunk fuse panel is described

specs.item: Engine-bay E-box / front power distribution box
specs.value: Exists (ETK front power distribution box 61149119445; fuseandrelay lists E-box fuses F01-F07 incl. 30 A ignition coils, 40 A coolant pump/DME main relay); JBE integrated in front power distribution box (ST502). Physical location and access not found
F30 20 A on both web layouts
ETK: S522A Xenon Light, S524A Adaptive Headlights; ST502: bi-xenon only with Adaptive Headlight Control on the launch E90; ST502: halogen is standard

Bulbs can be replaced without removing the headlight through service openings in the wheel arch covers (ST502); one E90Post poster reached the low beams by unscrewing a small cover in front of the wheel
Twist off the round finned cap on the back of the headlight from under the hood (no wheel removal); H8 bulb twists out; remove extra rubber washers on the new bulb
specs.note: Two E90Post threads (one E90 xenon, one 335i adaptive); a third post says wheel liner removal needed; a vendor guide for halogen LCI removes the rear covers. Treat as variant dependent.

specs.value: Turn wheels, remove liner screws (8 mm), peel back liner; no bumper removal
ST502 (launch E90): four bulbs per cluster accessed through a flap in the luggage compartment trim panel; LCI-specific steps not found

specs.item: Xenon bulb high voltage / battery disconnect
specs.value: BMW ST502: control unit supplies the ignition voltage for the bi-xenon bulb; HID work should be done with the lights off and battery negative disconnected per retailer guides

specs.item: Headlight must be re-aimed/coded after lamp replacement (adaptive)
specs.value: ST502: after replacing adaptive-headlight parts, coding/adaptation is needed and headlights must be adjusted and checked
specs.note: Applies to replacing control units/lamp assemblies, not to bulb swaps.

steps.title: Identify the failed circuit
steps.instruction: Switch ignition off and identify the circuit; use the diagram on the back of the glove-box fuse cover or the owner's manual to find the fuse. Layouts differ by build date and options.
warnings: Layout differs by year/options; use the sticker for this car.

steps.title: Open the glove-box fuse panel
steps.instruction: Open the glove box, turn the two round plastic quarter-turn fasteners counterclockwise to drop the cover, then photograph the layout before touching anything. The fuse chart is on the back of the cover (it can fall into the glove box).
warnings: Panel is tight to reach; a fuse puller helps.

steps.title: Swap the fuse
steps.instruction: Pull the suspect fuse, compare its colour/number with the chart, fit a new fuse of identical amp rating and colour. BMW colour code: 5 A light brown, 7.5 A brown, 10 A red, 15 A blue, 20 A yellow, 25 A white, 30 A green, 40 A orange.
warnings: Never fit a higher amp rating; a repeat blow means a short.
Check one fuse at a time and note what it does.

steps.title: Trunk fuses
steps.instruction: There is no replaceable-fuse panel in the trunk: the rear power distribution box on top of the battery contains fusible links that cannot be replaced individually and the box is replaced as a unit. Do not open it.
warnings: If a main supply fusible link is suspected, have the car checked; do not bypass.

steps.title: Engine-bay fuses (E-box / front power distribution box)
steps.instruction: The engine electronics fuse box (E-box) exists with fuses F01-F07 per a web chart (30 A ignition coils, 30 A coolant pump/thermostat, 20 A crank sensor/purge valve, 30 A crankcase and O2 heaters, 10 A E-box fan etc.). Its physical location and cover release are not documented in found sources.
warnings: Do not publish location or access steps without a source.

steps.title: Confirm the headlight type
steps.instruction: Look at the headlamp: standard halogen (H7) or bi-xenon (D1S, may be adaptive). Option codes S522A/S524A on the VIN decode mean xenon/adaptive. If unsure read the old bulb base marking.
warnings: Xenon bulbs run at high voltage; do not touch the ignition element or bulb with power on.

steps.title: Halogen H7 low/high-beam bulb
steps.instruction: Let the bulb cool, wear gloves. Reach the bulbs through the service opening in the wheel arch cover (turn the steering away; a small cover in front of the wheel unscrews), unplug the connector, release the retainer, swap the H7 12V 55W, refit and test. Some cars may allow access from under the hood; not established for this car.
warnings: Do not touch glass; replace in pairs for matching light.
Detailed latch/retainer geometry for E90 is not established; a generic guide describes a spring clip or twist ring.

steps.title: Xenon low-beam bulb (D1S)
steps.instruction: Switch lights off and disconnect the battery negative; remove the wheel and fender liner screws, open the bulb cover (six T20 per one retailer), press the retaining clips, pull and replace the D1S, plug in and test before reassembly; replace both sides together.
warnings: High voltage; support the car on stands; do not touch bulb glass.
If battery is disconnected, observe the reconnect items in the battery guide (clock/radio reset).

steps.title: Halo (angel-eye) bulb
steps.instruction: Under the hood, twist off the round finned cap behind the headlight, twist the H8 bulb toward the centre of the car to release, fit the new H8 with any extra rubber washers removed, refit cap. On halogen LCI lamps the bulb type is disputed (H8 vs H10W): match the old bulb.
warnings: Wiring bundle near the bulb can be tight.
Direction of twist is from one 335i post only.

steps.title: Fog bulb H8
steps.instruction: Turn the front wheels, remove the 8 mm liner screws at the front of the wheel liner, peel the liner back, twist out the H8 35W bulb and replace; refit liner.
warnings: Jack is optional per posters; use stands if lifting.

steps.title: Rear (tail/turn/reverse) bulbs
steps.instruction: Open the flap in the luggage compartment trim behind the lamp, remove the bulb carrier and swap the bulb. Bulb types per ETK: P21W, H21W, W16W; which socket does which job is not established for the LCI lamps.
warnings: Check whether your lamp functions are LED before ordering bulbs.

steps.title: Test and re-check
steps.instruction: Switch the lights on, confirm every function, and check the dash for bulb-out warnings.

safety: Ignition off before fuse work; same-rating and same-colour fuses only; never bridge a fuse.
Do not open the rear power distribution box on the battery.
HID (xenon) systems carry high voltage; lights off and battery disconnected before touching bulbs or ballast.
Do not handle halogen/xenon glass with bare fingers; let bulbs cool.
Use jack stands, never just a jack, if the wheel is removed.
After replacing adaptive-headlight components the lamps need coding and aim check.

The junction box fuse panel behind the glove box, reachable once the cover drops.

visuals.title: Front wheel-arch liner screws for fog/low-beam access

elements.describe: The black plastic front wheel-arch liner that is peeled back or unscrewed to reach the bulbs behind the bumper/headlight.
Several screws (8 mm head per one thread; Torx per one retailer) around the liner; bottom screws on the front part named by one poster.
A small cover in the liner/arch ahead of the wheel that BMW describes as the opening for bulb replacement.

facts.note: Three guides use the liner for access.
ST502 service openings in wheel arch covers; E90Post small cover in front of the wheel.
8 mm hex head (E90Post fog thread); bavmods lists T20/T30 and 8/10 mm; LUX lists 8/10 mm sockets. Sources differ; count and positions are not consistent.
LUX guide: 5 screws and 1 nut inside plus 4 underneath; bavmods six T20 for the cover; not reconciled.
All three route headlight/low-beam work through the front wheel-well (fender) liner.
Bimmerpost: 8 mm screws hold the black plastic liner; BAVMods: remove 8 mm fender liner screws and one 10 mm nut; LUX: 9 screws and 1 nut in total.
LUX: 5 screws and 1 nut inside the wheel well plus 4 on the bottom; Bimmerpost: two lower screws at the front edge of the liner. Counts differ, so show a handful of screws around the liner's edge.

mustNotDepict.reason: Count, head type and positions are not reconciled between sources; do not draw individual screws.
Exact shape and location of the cover in the liner is not established.
